what_to_detect: A resolution of a mass effect with no zone-specific text (DestroyAll, DamageAll, ChangeZoneAll ...) while the snapshot holds cards matching its selector outside the battlefield: its events touch only battlefield permanents, none of those cards.
near_miss: A resolution of the same kind whose events include a card outside the battlefield (an effect with zone-specific text).

what_to_detect: A resolution asking for N cards (discard, mill, draw, reveal) whose event count is below N, or which holds no such event, because fewer cards were available.
near_miss: A resolution of the same kind whose event count equals the N asked for.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose timing check passes outside its card's normal timing (a sorcery-speed card outside its controller's main phase or with a non-empty stack) because an active as-though static on the board permits it.
near_miss: A candidate of the same kind outside its normal timing with no such static, whose timing check fails.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate playable only through two as-though statics at once (for example cast from another player's graveyard and outside its normal timing): can_play true with both its zone and its timing outside the card's defaults.
near_miss: A candidate with only one of the two departures permitted, whose zone or timing check fails.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost is affordable only because an active static lets mana be spent as though it were mana of any colour or type: affordable true while the colours the board can produce do not cover the cost.
near_miss: A candidate with the same colour shortfall and no such static, unaffordable.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect is conditioned on the colour of mana spent, where the stack object's mana spent lacks that colour (mana spent as though it were that colour does not count): the conditioned segment is not met and its events are absent.
near_miss: A resolution of the same kind whose mana spent includes the colour, the segment met and its events present.
record_fields: card costs_paid mana spent per colour (gen-3)

what_to_detect: Damage dealt by a source a prevention shield was set for, after the source lost the property the shield names: the damage event happens while the shield is still in the command zone, and no rewrite record is written because the replacement's ValidSource no longer matches.
near_miss: Damage from a source that still has the property, prevented by the shield (a rewrite record with result prevented).
record_fields: floating_effects with remembered source and shield_left (gen-3)
